task_summary: Implement contiguous windows in solution.py and add standard-library unittest coverage in test_solution.py.
constraints: Work only in the supplied task workspace; do not access parent repositories or external services.
Use Python 3.11+ and the standard library.
Return all contiguous windows of exactly size, advancing by one.
Raise ValueError when size <= 0; return [] when size exceeds input length.
Maintain type hints and do not mutate input collections.
Include at least two passing unittest methods exercising the public API.
Cover ordinary, boundary, and empty inputs, or invalid numeric inputs when no collection is accepted.
Preserve the stated behavior and compatibility requirements.

success_criteria.description: solution.py contains the implementation and retains type hints.
test_solution.py contains at least two unittest test methods.
The implementation and tests pass unittest discovery.

assumptions: The workspace paths are relative to the supplied task workspace.
solution.py and test_solution.py may not exist yet and may be created.
The public API's function name and exact input collection type are unspecified; tests should exercise the API as implemented and document that choice.
The unittest discovery command is the requested verification mechanism; a zero exit code indicates discovery and execution completed without reported failures.
